payload.answer:
Virtualization. Defect support is available for virtualization environments where they relate to releases of this platform already supported by WebSphere MQ. Unless stated elsewhere in the system requirements WebSphere MQ has not been specifically tested in virtualization environments. 

WebSphere MQ support is therefore unable to assist in issues related to configuration and setup, or issues that are directly related to the virtualization environment itself. 

Please also refer to:
WebSphere MQ's support position on Virtualization, low-level hardware, file systems on networks and high availability. [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21392025] [S3]
The SPCR tool links to information about the minimum product levels that must be installed before opening a problem report with IBM WebSphere MQ Technical Support. The software versions and any maintenance levels listed in the tool have been explicitly verified as working. [S4]

source_lineage.excerpt:
IBM System Requirements for WebSphere MQ for HP OpenVMS V6 - United States

SOE WebSphere MQ OpenVMS V6.0 V6.0 version 6 version6.0 version6 requirements requirement requirements requirement requirements requirement requirements requirement requirements requirement ; SystemRequirementsDocument PRODUCT DOCUMENTATION

ABSTRACT
 This document contains the system requirements for WebSphere MQ on OpenVMS V6 

CONTENT
 WebSphere MQ for HP OpenVMS (Alpha) 

WebSphere MQ for HP OpenVMS (Itanium)


WebSphere MQ for HP OpenVMS (Alpha)



Please read first [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27013058&aid=1]  * The installation GUI for WebSphere MQ requires HP DECwindows Motif for OpenVMS.

Hardware [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27013058&aid=1]  * Any HP AlphaServer hardware capable of running OpenVMS Alpha V8.2 or V8.3

Operating Systems [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27013058&aid=1] The latest OpenVMS patches must be applied. 
 * OpenVMS Alpha V8.2 
 * OpenVMS Alpha V8.3 (including patch VMS83A_MQ-V0100, which is mandatory for WebSphere MQ)

Virtualization. Defect support is available for virtualization environments where they relate to releases of this platform already supported by WebSphere MQ. Unless stated elsewhere in the system requirements WebSphere MQ has not been specifically tested in virtualization environments. 

WebSphere MQ support is therefore unable to assist in issues related to configuration and setup, or issues that are directly related to the virtualization environment itself. 

Please also refer to:
WebSphere MQ's support position on Virtualization, low-level hardware, file systems on networks and high availability. [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21392025]

The SPCR tool links to information about the minimum product levels that must be installed before opening a problem report with IBM WebSphere MQ Technical Support. The software versions and any maintenance levels listed in the tool have been explicitly verified as working.

Hardware requirements [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27011919&aid=1]  * Any IBM OS/390 or zSeries 900 processor capable of running the required level of a compatible operating system with enough storage to meet the combined requirements of the programming prerequisites, WebSphere MQ for z/OS, the access methods, and the application programs.

Operating Systems [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27011919&aid=1]  * z/OS V1.8 or later [see section note 1]


Notes:  1. WebSphere MQ V7.0 has a hard pre-requisite on z/OS V1.8, so prior versions of z/OS are not supported.

* Defect support is available for virtualization environments where they relate to releases of this platform already supported by WebSphere MQ. Unless stated elsewhere in the system requirements, WebSphere MQ has not been specifically tested in virtualization environments. WebSphere MQ Support is therefore unable to assist in issues related to configuration and setup, or issues that are directly related to the virtualization environment itself.

Operating Systems [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27006594&aid=1]  * IBM z/OS V1R5 (5694-A01), with PTF for APAR OA11699, at RSU0507 or later (for the target system). 
 * IBM SMP/E for z/OS V3R1 or later (SMP/E PTF for APAR IR48947 is required for the driving system.) 

Hardware Requirements [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27006594&aid=1]  * Any server capable of running one of the listed IBM z/OS releases 

WebSphere MQ [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27006594&aid=1]  * IBM WebSphere MQ V5.3.1 for z/OS (5655-F10) (plus PTF for APAR PQ80677), including the FMID for MQ Java™ Classes. 
 * IBM WebSphere MQ for z/OS, V6.0 [http://www.ibm.com/software/integration/wmq/] 
 * IBM WebSphere MQ for z/OS, V7.0 [http://www.ibm.com/software/integration/wmq/] [see note 6] 
 * IBM WebSphere MQ for z/OS, V7.0.1 [http://www.ibm.com/software/integration/wmq/] [see notes 6 and 7]

XML Toolkit [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27006594&aid=1]  * XML Toolkit V1.8 for z/OS 

JDK [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27006594&aid=1] Broker requires either:  * Java Runtime Environment Version 1.4.2 (Fix Pack 2) [http://www.ibm.com/servers/eserver/zseries/software/java/]
